bandReport.notes: COMPLETE. Image->printed-page mapping VERIFIED against every footer (TFDD-A-HTM/37C): p06=13, p08=15, p09=17, p10=19, p11=21 — exactly as briefed, no mismatch. SEAMS BOTH CLEAN: p05 (printed 11) ends with Q30 whole (all 4 options on the page) and p12 (printed 23) opens at Q61, so no question straddles either boundary and nothing is unowned. Q31-Q60 = 30 questions, contiguous, no gaps. Devanagari slivers from the facing page appear at the LEFT edge of p09, p10 and p12 as expected from the spread crop; ignored, not transcribed. All four options of every question were read label by label off the page; every option block sitting under the red watermark (Q33 statements, Q37, Q39, Q44, Q46, Q50, Q55, Q57, Q60) was re-cropped at 2.4x-4x and re-read before being written. Nothing was copied between questions — note that Q33 and Q36 genuinely share the identical option set (I only / II only / Both I and II / Neither I nor II), as do Q52, and Q35/Q38/Q40 share -1 / 0 / 1 style sets; each was read independently. NO OPTION WAS UNREADABLE. PRINTED DEFECT, transcribed as printed and not repaired: Q42's integrand denominator is set as (ax + bx + c)^2 — confirmed at 2.6x, the first term really is 'ax' with no square, so the printed quadratic is degenerate; the options (which involve a+b+c) suggest the intended form is (ax^2 + bx + c)^2. Flagged in the stem text so a matcher is not surprised. Q54 option (a)'s middle operator was checked at 3x because it renders faintly: it is a PLUS (x + 2y + 3z - 28 = 0), identical in glyph to the plus in option (d).

questions.stem: What is the domain of the function f(x) = log_x e?
If f(x) is the integral of (1 + cos^2 x - 2cos x)/(x sin^2 x tan x) then what is lim_{x->0} f'(x) equal to?

Consider the following statements in respect of the function f(x) = [3x], where [.] is the greatest integer function : I. f(x) is continuous at x = 1/3. II. f(x) is differentiable at x = 1/4. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
What is lim_{x->0} sin^2 x / (x|x|) equal to?
Let f(x) = p|x| + q, where p and q are real constants. If f'(x) exists at x = 0, then what is the value of p?

Consider the following statements in respect of the given function : f(x) = x^3/|x| for x != 0, and 0 for x = 0. I. f(x) is continuous everywhere. II. f(x) is differentiable everywhere. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
What is lim_{x->infinity} (sqrt(x + sqrt(x)) - sqrt(x)) equal to?
If m and n are the roots of the equation x^2 - px + q = 0, then what is lim_{x->m} (e^(x^2 - px + q) - 1)/((x - m)(x - n)) equal to?
Let f(x) = x^n + k, where n is a natural number and k is a positive real constant such that f(x) + f(1/x) = f(x)f(1/x) and f(2) = 9. What is f(-1) equal to?
If f(x) = cos{(pi/3)[x] + x} for 1 < x < 2, where [.] is the greatest integer function, then what is f(pi/2) equal to?
What is integral sqrt(x)/sqrt(1 - x^3) dx equal to?
What is integral from 0 to 1 of dx/(ax + bx + c)^2 equal to? [printed as (ax + bx + c)^2 — transcribed as printed]
What is integral e^(x ln 10) e^x dx equal to?
What is integral from 1 to 2 of x^x (1 + ln x) dx equal to?
If f(x + y) = f(x) + f(y), then what is integral from -1 to 1 of f(x) dx equal to?

questions.stem: What is the area bounded by y = e^|x| and the lines |x| = 1 and y = 0?
The slope of the tangent to the curve y = f(x) at (x, f(x)) is 2x. If the curve passes through the origin, then what is the area bounded by the curve, the x-axis and the line x = 1?
What is the solution of y dx - x dy - y^2 cos x dx = 0?
What is the differential equation of the family of straight lines passing through the origin?
What is the degree of the differential equation representing the family of curves y^2 = sqrt(c) x, where c is a positive parameter?
The vertices of a triangle are A(2, 0, 0), B(0, 6, 0) and C(0, 0, 4). If AD, BE and CF are the medians of the triangle, then what is AD^2 + BE^2 + CF^2 equal to?

A line makes angles alpha, beta and gamma with the positive directions of x-axis, y-axis and z-axis respectively such that alpha + beta = 90 degrees. Which of the following statements is/are correct? I. The maximum value of cos alpha + cos beta is sqrt(2). II. The minimum value of cos alpha + cos beta + cos gamma is 1. Select the answer using the code given below.
What is the area of the triangle whose vertices are (0, 7, 10), (-1, 6, 6) and (-4, 9, 6)?
If O is the origin and P is the point (2, -4, 6), then what is the equation of the plane through P and perpendicular to OP?
The image of the point P(1, 3, 4) with respect to the plane Ax + By + Cz + D = 0 is (-3, 5, 2). If A + B + C = 2, then what is D equal to?

questions.stem: Let a, b, c and d be the vectors. Consider the following : I. (a x b).(c x d)  II. (a x b) x (c x d)  III. (a.b).(c.d)  IV. (a.b) x (c.d)  V. {(a x b).c} x d — where '.' represents dot product and 'x' represents cross product of vectors. How many of the above are not well-defined?
The scalar projection of a = lambda i + j - 2k on b = 2i - j - lambda k is 7/3. What is the value of lambda?
How much angle does r = (cos theta) i + (sin theta) j + k make with the positive direction of z-axis?
Let a and b be unit vectors inclined at 30 degrees. What is the area of the parallelogram whose sides are represented by the vectors a + 3b and 3a + b?
Let a, b and c be unit vectors such that a.b = a.c = 0. If the angle between b and c is pi/6, then what is a equal to?
